result.title: 未註銷藥品許可證資料集
result.description: 本資料集僅提供未註銷藥品許可證資料，每週與藥證業務管理系統同步，藉此提供醫師、藥師、醫護人員、業者、民眾等使用者使用。
result.notes:
符合OAS標準之API說明文件網址:https://data.fda.gov.tw/
資料量大，以ZIP壓縮。
中藥藥品，請至此網站查詢： 
http://www.mohw.gov.tw/CHT/DOCMAP/query_liense.aspx?mode=1
警語:請勿自行決定用藥，使用藥品前，仍須經醫師診斷、醫師處方、藥師指導用藥後，方可為之。

en.title: The information collection for the uncancelled drug permit.
en.description: This data set provides information on drug licenses that have not been cancelled, which is synchronized with the drug certification business management system on a weekly basis, and is provided for use by physicians, pharmacists, medical personnel, businesses, and the general public.
en.notes: The API documentation URL that complies with the OAS standard: https://data.fda.gov.tw/opendata/exportDataList.do?methodopenDataApi&InfoId37The data is large and compressed in ZIP format.For traditional Chinese medicine, please check the following website: http://www.mohw.gov.tw/CHT/DOCMAP/query_liense.aspx?mode1Warning: Do not decide to use medication on your own. Before using medication, you still need to be diagnosed by a doctor, prescribed by a doctor, and guided by a pharmacist.

resources.description: This dataset only provides information on unrevoked drug permits, which is synchronized with the drug permit business management system every week to provide access for users such as physicians, pharmacists, healthcare personnel, operators, and the public.
resources.fieldDesc: Permit number、Cancelled status、Cancellation date、Reason for Cancellation、Expiration Date、Issuance date、Types of permits、Old Certificate Number、Clearance visa application file number、Product name、Product name、Indication、Dosage form、Packaging、Drug category、Controlled substance classification level、Principal component analysis、Business name application、Business address application、Apply for a unified business number、Manufacturer name、Factory address、Manufacturer company address、Country of manufacture、Process、Change date、Dosage and administration、Packaging and International Barcode
resources.note: The API documentation URL that complies with OAS standards: https://data.fda.gov.tw/opendata/exportDataList.do?methodopenDataApi&InfoId37The data is extensive and compressed as a ZIP file.For Chinese herbal medicines, please refer to this website: http://www.mohw.gov.tw/CHT/DOCMAP/query_liense.aspx?mode1Caution: Do not self-prescribe medication. Before using any medication, a diagnosis by a physician, a prescription from a physician, and guidance from a pharmacist are still necessary.
